page-error-description: We could not load this page. Try again, or head back home.
glass-intro: Clear glass catches light along its bevel and gently refracts the page at its edge. Move your cursor to explore the reflections; tapping keeps the surface still.
glass-cursor-description: On a fine pointer, the cursor moves a soft reflection along the bevel. Text and hit areas stay fixed. Touch and reduced motion keep the material still, with no tap ripples.
